name: Main Gate
description: The main campus entrance used by students visitors and vehicles to enter JUET.
where_to_find_it: At the main entry to the JUET campus. Use it as the starting point for the internal campus road.
nearby_notes: The virtual tour describes a main road in front of the Main Entry and hostel, with Tuck Shop Cafeteria and a pathway to the Mess along that corridor. This does not mean all are directly beside the gate.

name: Nehru Plaza
description: A central campus reference point useful for orientation and meeting other students.
where_to_find_it: Identified as the campus Centre Point in JUET's official virtual tour.
nearby_notes: JUET's 2020-21 AQAR describes the Multipurpose Hall Sports Ground and open lawn as near Nehru Plaza; exact distances are not published.

name: Academic Block Area
description: The main teaching area containing academic buildings lecture theatres classrooms laboratories and departments.
where_to_find_it: JUET's virtual tour includes a viewpoint at the front of every Academic Block and at the centre of the Academic Block.
nearby_notes: LT-1 is documented in Ramanujan Bhavan; LRC is documented in Vishvesvaraya Bhawan. JUET's older AQAR names three academic blocks.

name: LT-1
description: A lecture theatre used for academic sessions and examinations; JUET's PGET-2025 instructions list it as an exam venue.
where_to_find_it: Inside Ramanujan Bhavan in the academic block area.
nearby_notes: Exact entrance floor and closest neighbouring room are not given publicly; confirm on site.

name: Lecture Theatres LT-2 to LT-5
description: Provisional search group for four lecture-theatre destinations named individually in JUET's virtual-tour index.
building_or_area: Academic / theatre area; individual Bhawan assignments not confirmed
where_to_find_it: Look in the academic/theatre area and follow the individual LT labels. This record groups the four names until their separate physical positions are captured.
nearby_notes: Do not place all four labels at one coordinate. Split into four records once each theatre entrance is confirmed.

name: Learning Resource Centre (LRC)
description: The university library and learning resource centre with books journals digital resources and computer access.
where_to_find_it: Inside Vishvesvaraya Bhawan one of JUET's academic buildings.
nearby_notes: The official 2026 brochure confirms the building name. Exact floor and nearest entrance should be confirmed on site.

name: Administrative Offices
description: Administrative destination covering the Registrar Office and other senior university offices.
building_or_area: Administrative area; exact block not confirmed
where_to_find_it: Use Registrar Office as the primary search term. JUET's tour also marks the ramp viewpoint in front of the Registrar Office.
nearby_notes: The public tour index does not specify the exact building arrangement or walking distance between offices. Verify before assigning one pin.
sub_location_names: Registrar Office|VC Office|Board Room|Chancellor Office|Registrar Office Ramp Viewpoint

name: Tagore Hall / Multipurpose Hall (MPH)
description: A large indoor hall used for university events cultural programmes presentations and indoor sports.
where_to_find_it: Near Nehru Plaza according to JUET's 2020-21 AQAR; the official virtual tour labels it as MPH.
nearby_notes: The nearby relationship is supported by an older university AQAR. Exact entrance orientation and distance need on-site verification.

name: Sports Ground
description: Outdoor sports area for activities such as football cricket and other field/court sports.
where_to_find_it: Near Nehru Plaza according to JUET's 2020-21 AQAR.
nearby_notes: The nearby relationship is supported by an older university AQAR. Exact field entrance and court locations need field verification.

name: Shopping Centre / Tuck Shops / Cafeteria
description: Campus convenience cluster including tuck shops a multipurpose shop grocery bakery ice-cream shop and cafeteria.
building_or_area: Main-road corridor in front of Main Entry and hostel
where_to_find_it: Use the main road in front of the Main Entry and hostel. JUET's virtual tour associates this corridor with the Tuck Shop and Cafeteria.
nearby_notes: The tour describes a shared main-road corridor and a pathway to the Mess; verify exact shop-by-shop positions.
sub_location_names: Tuck Shop 1|Tuck Shop 2|Multipurpose Shop|Grocery Shop|Bakery|Ice-Cream Shop|Cafeteria

name: Annapurna Student Mess
description: JUET student dining facility with separate Annapurna messes for boys and girls.
building_or_area: Mess complex; approach via the main-road pathway
where_to_find_it: Follow the pathway to the Mess mentioned in the virtual-tour description of the main road in front of the Main Entry and hostel.
nearby_notes: The tour confirms a pathway to the Mess from the main-road corridor. Confirm boys' and girls' dining entrances separately.

name: Hostel Area (Boys' and Girls' Hostels)
description: Student residential area with separate boys' and girls' facilities. JUET's hostel page lists 21 boys' hostel blocks and a separate girls' hostel.
building_or_area: Hostel-side campus road and residential clusters
where_to_find_it: JUET's virtual tour identifies the main road in front of the hostel and separate viewpoints for Boys Hostel and Girls Hostel.
nearby_notes: The virtual tour places Tuck Shop Cafeteria and the Mess pathway on the main-road corridor in front of the Main Entry and hostel. Confirm each hostel route separately.
sub_location_names: Boys Hostel Blocks|Girls Hostel|Back of Hostel 6
